hook: Nova Scotia workplace injury time-loss dropped to 185 days per 100 workers in November 2026.

sections.voiceover: Nova Scotia workplace injury time-loss dropped to 185 days per 100 workers in November 2026.
This November 2026 data reflects a steady decline in time-loss injury claims across Nova Scotia. Did the time-loss injury rate actually fall from 1.40 claims per 100 workers in 2023?
However, the Workers' Compensation Board of Nova Scotia reports a 25 percent drop since 2025.
WCB Nova Scotia confirms this 25 percent reduction in time-loss days per 100 covered workers.
Safety News Canada confirms this new low of 185 days per 100 workers for the province.
